name: Transport CT-O5
description: Transport CT-05 was a New Republic transport ship used in the Corellia shipyards to transport heavy parts from a sector to another. The transport was heavily armed with twin fire-linked turrets on its wings as well as on its rear to defend against pursuers, and possessed a hyperdrive unit that allowed it to jump between star systems.

data.name: Transport CT-O5
data.capacity: At least one Super Star Destroyer hyperdrive core
